_readme: The timing sheet from the scene run by hand on 2026-09-18 — one voice paragraph of 8.92 s and the four beat windows read off it — with the ids replaced by invented ones and the scene renamed to the fixture's own. Shape: what machine/voice.py writes to <run>/vo/timing.json.

lines.text: It comes back in the same place every time.
That is not the product failing.
That is the thing underneath it, doing what it does.
Once you know that, you stop buying the same answer.
Reaching for the top shelf, and checking first who can see.
That is the part nobody says out loud.
